Pause this optional bee-pollen product if stomach symptoms are troublesome, persist or worsen, and seek clinical advice before continuing. Repeated vomiting or signs of dehydration need advice today; severe abdominal pain or marked dehydration needs urgent assessment now. If symptoms occur with mouth or throat swelling, breathing trouble, faintness or collapse, call your local emergency number, 112 in the EU, and follow your prescribed anaphylaxis plan. Do not take the product again to test a suspected allergy.
